resolution: Acted on the standing 'commit early/often, stop asking' feedback by reflexively committing the session's work instead of asking again: staged the entire previously-untracked but coherent cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/ Studio editor unit by explicit path (never -A) and committed it as d2ac77028, which also lands req_1163/1164/1165. Saved the rule to durable memory (feedback_commit_reflexively_never_ask) so future instances treat committing as reflex, not a decision point. Note: the follow-on push to origin failed on a pre-existing empty .git object (kernel-panic-interrupted write), which is a separate concern tracked as req_1167 — the commit itself is safe and local.
